# aidial_toolset (Data Source)

Reads an existing toolset stored in DIAL Core resource storage without managing it. Use `aidial_file_toolset` for toolsets defined in static (file) configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A toolset stored in DIAL Core resource storage, for example one managed
# elsewhere with the aidial_toolset resource.
data "aidial_toolset" "search" {
  bucket = "platform"
  path   = "my-toolset"
}

output "toolset_endpoint" {
  value = data.aidial_toolset.search.endpoint
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bucket` (String) DIAL bucket, for example `platform` or `public`.
- `path` (String) Toolset path inside the bucket.

### Read-Only

- `allowed_tools` (Set of String) Names of the tools the toolset exposes.
- `api_name` (String) Canonical toolset name returned by the DIAL API.
- `auth_settings` (Attributes) How DIAL Core authenticates to the toolset. The client secret is never exposed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--auth_settings))
- `author` (String) Toolset author.
- `base_url` (String) Toolset-level base URL used by `interfaces` entries without their own `base_url`.
- `catalog_properties` (Dynamic) Catalog metadata of the toolset (free-form object).
- `catalog_schema_id` (String) URI (`$id`) of the catalog schema describing `catalog_properties`.
- `default_headers` (Map of String) Additional headers sent with every request to the toolset's endpoint.
- `defaults` (Dynamic) Default request parameters (free-form object).
- `dependencies` (Set of String) Deployments the toolset depends on.
- `description` (String) Toolset description.
- `description_keywords` (Set of String) Keywords describing the toolset.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable toolset name.
- `display_version` (String) Version shown for the toolset.
- `endpoint` (String) Toolset MCP endpoint.
- `features` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--features))
- `forward_auth_token` (Boolean)
- `forward_per_request_key` (Boolean)
- `icon_url` (String) URL of the toolset icon.
- `id` (String) Resource identifier in the form <bucket>/<path>.
- `input_attachment_types` (Set of String) MIME types of accepted input attachments.
- `interceptors` (Set of String) Interceptors applied to requests.
- `interfaces` (Attributes Map) Per-interface deployment configuration, keyed by DIAL Core interface type (`openaiChatCompletions`, `openaiEmbeddings`, `openaiResponses`, `anthropicMessages`). `translator`, `defaults` and `features` are not modeled. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--interfaces))
- `intro` (String) Introductory text shown for the toolset.
- `max_input_attachments` (Number)
- `max_retry_attempts` (Number)
- `name` (String) Toolset name returned by the DIAL API.
- `override_name` (String) Override of the toolset name presented to clients.
- `provider_name` (String) Name of the toolset provider (`provider` in the DIAL API).
- `reference` (String) Reference URL.
- `responses_defaults` (Dynamic) Default request parameters for Responses API requests (free-form object).
- `responses_endpoint` (String) Endpoint used for Responses API requests.
- `transport` (String) MCP transport: `HTTP` or `SSE`.
- `user_roles` (Set of String) Roles allowed to use the toolset.
- `vendor_website` (String) Website of the toolset vendor.
